https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3373574502

notes.title: Really positive impression from Rock Paper Shotgun + a small patch
notes.notes:
We have a small patch but we wanted to bring up some positive press we got as well! This Rock Paper Shotgun article (link) is short and sweet but the writer really likes our game!

Some highlights are "How two people developed this is beyond me" and that the game's locations "look 1000% more interesting and quirky than a lot of worlds I've seen in retro-filed platformers nowadays." We also appreciate the term "bizzarovanias".

And about the patch, the changes are few:
- fixed issues with the "Full Health After Death" and "Infinite Other Berries" cheats in the cheat menu not becoming active

Mac and Linux are up to date now as well as Windows (v1.02)

notes.title: Jumping and movement is now faster! + Demo patch notes
notes.notes:
Hi everyone. After the feedback from Next Fest we decided to change the jump speeds (in other words you don't stay in the air as long), in addition to the big change from earlier where you can now manually cancel out of your dash instead of being forced to lose momentum. We've also made the character less "slippery" and subtly sped up the horizontal movement speeds too.

As for our progress towards a finished game, we're working hard on it and have a lot of fun stuff in store! We recently added a unique stealth mechanic for a particular area, some fun cutscenes, among other things. We're looking forward to getting the chance to share it all!

Thanks for playing! We have the full patch notes for the demo below.

demo v0.03 patch notes:

 player jump/gravity sped up
 player horizontal movement sped up slightly (+ being able to cancel out of dashes from last patch)
 player starting/stopping momentum changed to be less "slippery"
 can air-dash only once per jump now (there will be upgrades for this in the full game)
 added sound effect when walking past triangular puzzle elements
 minor graphical change
